title: Make a second page
summary: Astro uses the pages folder to create routes.
introduction: Astro uses the pages folder to create routes. Your task: Add an about.astro page.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for make a second page

blocks.text: Astro uses the pages folder to create routes. A file named books.astro creates a books page.
Use an Astro project. Save examples at the shown src paths. Astro files are built into HTML and need the Astro tool; they do not run as plain HTML in this playground.
Read the code step by step

items: The file path under src/pages creates the route.
The list is ordinary HTML that remains readable without a client framework.

blocks.text: The /books route contains a simple book list.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Create pages in src/pages. A component in src/components does not get its own route automatically.
